findings.location: vector B01 (item i4: x11, s9, s10, x12, s11); scripts/topology_coordination.py _Board.apply (MERGE: on_work); README A2 'Verdict history, per work' and the M4R2-2 disposition ('A stays VERDICT_NOT_PASS')
findings.finding: The per-work merge rule is not pinned in the one case where it matters: merging the failed work after the revised work has passed. On i4 the vectors merge A only before B's PASS (s10 at 132; x12 is at 133), and then merge B (s11). Two mutants pass every vector. R01 reads the status from the claim's latest verdict instead of this work's latest. R02 counts only the latest verdict's work. Probe P01 adds a MERGE of work A at t=134 (after x12, before s11): the model answers VERDICT_NOT_PASS and then merges B; R01 answers ACCEPTED and merges the FAILed work A; R02 answers WORK_MISMATCH. So an implementation that merges FAILed work whenever any later verdict on the claim passed satisfies every published vector. The model itself is right.
findings.requiredChange: Add a MERGE of work A after x12 on i4 (for example opId s10b at t=134, VERDICT_NOT_PASS), so that both R01 and R02 are killed.

findings.location: vectors T51 and stores.splits; scripts/topology_coordination.py _held_out (held_ids) and check_transcript (tenantId shape)
findings.finding: Two rules are still unpinned. (1) The task-ID route of MAS-RA-002's held-out rule counts only declarations in the record's own suite. T51 proves the ID route fires within one suite, but no vector shows that a declaration in another suite holding out the same task ID does not make a record ineligible. The mutant that drops the suite condition (N03) passes every vector. Round 2's required change asked for this ('another suite must not count'), so the M4R2-3 disposition is partial. (2) The new transcript tenantId is SHAPE-checked as MAS-RA-001 scope text (1..256 characters, no surrogate). B09t covers only its absence, so a mutant that drops the text check (R08) passes every vector. Schema and model agree on empty, 257-character, surrogate, numeric and null tenants (probe P05).
findings.requiredChange: Add a valid declaration in another suite that holds out one of a still-eligible record's DEVELOPMENT task IDs (with another task digest), and keep that record's topology valid. Add a SHAPE vector with an empty or 257-character tenantId.
